4	// Usage: node scripts/rdt.mjs <file-list> <tsconfig> <out.json>
5	import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
6	import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
7	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
8	
9	const require = createRequire(fileURLToPath(new URL('../apps/oracle/package.json', import.meta.url)))
10	const { withCustomConfig } = require('react-docgen-typescript')
11	
12	const [listFile, tsconfig, out] = process.argv.slice(2)
13	if (!out) {
14	  console.error('usage: node scripts/rdt.mjs <file-list> <tsconfig> <out.json>')
15	  process.exit(2)
16	}
17	const files = readFileSync(listFile, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean)
18	const start = performance.now()
19	const parser = withCustomConfig(tsconfig, {
20	  shouldExtractLiteralValuesFromEnum: true,
21	  shouldRemoveUndefinedFromOptional: true,
22	  propFilter: { skipPropsWithoutDoc: false },
23	})
24	const docs = parser.parse(files)
25	const wallMs = performance.now() - start
26	const components = docs.map((d) => ({
27	  file: d.filePath,
28	  name: d.displayName,
29	  props: Object.fromEntries(
30	    Object.entries(d.props ?? {}).map(([k, p]) => [
31	      k,
32	      {
33	        required: Boolean(p.required),
34	        type: p.type?.name ?? '',
35	        parent: p.parent?.fileName ?? p.declarations?.[0]?.fileName ?? '',
36	      },
37	    ]),
38	  ),
39	}))
40	// `maxRSS` is in kilobytes on every platform Node supports.
41	const peakRssMiB = process.resourceUsage().maxRSS / 1024
42	writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({ wallMs, peakRssMiB, components }))
43	console.error(`dumped ${components.length} components in ${(wallMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s, ${peakRssMiB.toFixed(0)} MiB`)

2	// scripts/rdt.mjs writes, plus its own wall time and peak RSS. It reads each file on its own with its default
3	// resolver and importer, as Storybook does, so it knows nothing about types declared in other files.
4	//
5	// Usage: node scripts/rdg.mjs <file-list> <out.json>
6	import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
7	import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
8	import { pathToFileURL, fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
9	
10	const require = createRequire(fileURLToPath(new URL('../apps/oracle/package.json', import.meta.url)))
11	const { parse } = await import(pathToFileURL(require.resolve('react-docgen')).href)
12	
13	const [listFile, out] = process.argv.slice(2)
14	if (!out) {
15	  console.error('usage: node scripts/rdg.mjs <file-list> <out.json>')
16	  process.exit(2)
17	}
18	const files = readFileSync(listFile, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean)
19	const components = []
20	let failed = 0
21	const start = performance.now()
22	for (const file of files) {
23	  try {
24	    for (const doc of parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'), { filename: file })) {
25	      components.push({
26	        file,
27	        name: doc.displayName ?? '',
28	        props: Object.fromEntries(
29	          Object.entries(doc.props ?? {}).map(([k, p]) => [
30	            k,
31	            { required: Boolean(p.required), type: p.tsType?.raw ?? p.tsType?.name ?? '', parent: '' },
32	          ]),
33	        ),
34	      })
35	    }
36	  } catch {
37	    failed += 1
38	  }
39	}

42	const peakRssMiB = process.resourceUsage().maxRSS / 1024
43	writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({ wallMs, peakRssMiB, failed, components }))

92	/** The props type of a component export, the way react-docgen-typescript finds it. */
93	function propsTypeOf(exported: any): any | undefined {
94	  const symbol = exported.flags & SymbolFlags.Alias ? checker.getAliasedSymbol(exported) : exported
95	  const type = checker.getTypeOfSymbol(symbol)
96	  for (const sig of checker.getSignaturesOfType(type, SignatureKind.Call)) {
97	    const params = sig.getParameters()
98	    if (params.length === 1 || params[0]?.name === 'props') return checker.getTypeOfSymbol(params[0])

108	/** A default export is named by what it exports: the aliased declaration, or the function or class itself. */

117	  prop: string
118	  caliper: unknown

129	  file: string

138	  componentsMatched: 0,

147	/** The verdict for one prop, made once per (Caliper prop, checker type). */
148	function judge({
149	  component,
150	  prop,
151	  caliperId,
152	  type,
153	}: {
154	  component: string
155	  prop: string
156	  caliperId: string
157	  type: any
158	}) {

160	  const cached = verdictCache.get(key)

163	  const k: Norm = checkerNorm(type)

168	    examples[verdict].push({
169	      component,
170	      prop,
171	      caliper: caliper.props[caliperId].type,
172	      checker: checkerText,
173	      normalized: { caliper: c, checker: k },
174	    })
175	  }
176	  return verdict
177	}
178	
179	/** Every prop of one exported component the checker finds, against Caliper's component of the same name. */
180	function visitExport(exported: any, candidates: { name: string; key: string; component: any }[], file: string): void {
181	  let propsType
182	  try {
183	    propsType = propsTypeOf(exported)
184	  } catch {
185	    totals.failedExports++
186	    return
187	  }
188	  if (!propsType) return
189	  const props = checker.getPropertiesOfType(propsType)
190	  if (props.length === 0) return
191	  totals.componentsChecker++
192	  const name = exportName(exported)
193	  // React's DOM attributes are one inherited layer; ref and key are deliberately absent from Caliper's output.
194	  const own = props.filter(
195	    (p: any) =>
196	      p.name !== 'ref' &&
197	      p.name !== 'key' &&
198	      !p.declarations?.some((d: any) => String(d.path).includes('/@types/react/')),
199	  )
200	  totals.propsChecker += own.length
201	  const matches = candidates.filter((c) => c.name === normComponent(name))
202	  if (matches.length > 1) {
203	    totals.ambiguousExports++
204	    return
205	  }
206	  const [match] = matches
207	  if (!match) return
208	  totals.componentsMatched++
209	  const shared = own.filter((p: any) => p.name in match.component.props)
210	  const layerFiles = new Set(
211	    (match.component.inheritance ?? [])
212	      .filter((layer: any) => layer.totalProps > 30)
213	      .map((layer: any) => pathKey(String(layer.fileName))),
214	  )
215	  const absent = own.filter((p: any) => !(p.name in match.component.props))
216	  const collapsed: any[] = []
217	  const missing: any[] = []
218	  for (const p of absent) {
219	    if (p.declarations?.some((d: any) => layerFiles.has(pathKey(String(d.path))))) collapsed.push(p)
220	    else missing.push(p)
221	  }
222	  totals.propsMissing += missing.length
223	  totals.propsCollapsed += collapsed.length
224	  if (args.rows) rows.push(...missing.map((p: any) => [match.key, p.name, 'missing'] as [string, string, 'missing']))
225	  if (args.rows)
226	    rows.push(...collapsed.map((p: any) => [match.key, p.name, 'collapsed'] as [string, string, 'collapsed']))
227	  if (args.missing) {
228	    for (const [verdict, absentProps] of [
229	      ['missing', missing],
230	      ['collapsed', collapsed],
231	    ] as const) {
232	      for (const p of absentProps) {
233	        missingDetails.push({
234	          key: match.key,
235	          prop: p.name,
236	          verdict,
237	          declarations: p.declarations?.map((d: any) => String(d.path)) ?? [],
238	        })
239	      }
240	    }
241	  }
242	  if (shared.length === 0) return
243	  const types = checker.getTypeOfSymbol(shared)
244	  for (const [i, p] of shared.entries()) {
245	    totals.propsShared++
246	    const caliperId = match.component.props[p.name]
247	    const verdict = judge({ component: name, prop: p.name, caliperId, type: types[i] })
248	    counts[verdict]++
249	    if (args.rows) rows.push([match.key, p.name, verdict])
250	    if (args.dump && (verdict === 'wrong' || verdict === 'less precise')) {
251	      dumped.push({
252	        key: match.key,
253	        file: rel(file),
254	        component: name,
255	        prop: p.name,
256	        verdict,
257	        caliper: caliper.props[caliperId].type,
258	        checker: checker.typeToString(types[i]),

260	    }
261	  }
262	}

275	  components_matched: totals.componentsMatched,
276	  props_checker: totals.propsChecker,
277	  props_shared: totals.propsShared,
278	  props_missing: totals.propsMissing,
279	  props_collapsed: totals.propsCollapsed,

282	  failed_exports: totals.failedExports,

2	import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
3	import { compare, prim, type Norm } from '../src/oracle-compare.ts'
4	
5	const lit = (value: string): Norm => ({ k: 'lit', value })
6	const union = (...members: Norm[]): Norm => ({ k: 'union', members })
7	const undef = prim('undefined')
8	const optional = (type: Norm): Norm => union(type, undef)
9	
10	describe('the oracle comparison', () => {
11	  it('a type parameter Caliper replaced with its default is one instance of it, not another type', () => {
12	    expect.hasAssertions()
13	    // `multiple?: Multiple` with `Multiple extends boolean = false`, which Caliper reads as `false`.
14	    const multiple: Norm = { k: 'param', name: 'Multiple', fallback: lit('false'), constraint: prim('boolean') }
15	    expect(compare(lit('false'), optional(multiple))).toBe('less precise')
16	    expect(compare(prim('boolean'), optional(multiple))).toBe('less precise')
17	  })
18	
19	  it('a parameter with neither a default nor a constraint holds whatever instance Caliper picked', () => {
20	    expect.hasAssertions()
21	    // antd's `Segmented`: `defaultValue?: ValueType` where the cast over `forwardRef` declares `<ValueType>` bare and
22	    // the props interface declares the default Caliper used.
23	    const valueType: Norm = { k: 'param', name: 'ValueType' }
24	    expect(compare(union(prim('string'), prim('number')), optional(valueType))).toBe('less precise')
25	  })
26	
27	  it('a literal a primitive of its kind in the same union covers adds nothing', () => {
28	    expect.hasAssertions()
29	    // antd's `DrawerPanel`: `size?: 'default' | 'large' | number | string`, which the checker reduces to `string | number`.
30	    const written = union(lit('default'), lit('large'), prim('number'), prim('string'))
31	    expect(compare(written, optional(union(prim('string'), prim('number'))))).toBe('identical')
32	    // Without the primitive the literals are still the type.
33	    expect(compare(union(lit('default'), lit('large')), optional(union(lit('default'), lit('large'))))).toBe(
34	      'identical',
35	    )
36	    // A numeric literal is covered by `number`, not by `string`.
37	    expect(compare(union(lit('1'), prim('string')), optional(union(lit('1'), prim('string'))))).toBe('identical')
38	  })
39	
40	  it('a type parameter replaced with its constraint is one instance of it', () => {
41	    expect.hasAssertions()
42	    // `value?: Value` with `Value extends string`, which Caliper reads as `string`.
43	    const value: Norm = { k: 'param', name: 'Value', constraint: prim('string') }
44	    expect(compare(prim('string'), optional(value))).toBe('less precise')
45	  })
46	
47	  it('a type that is neither the default nor the constraint of the parameter is wrong', () => {
48	    expect.hasAssertions()
49	    const value: Norm = { k: 'param', name: 'Value', fallback: prim('string'), constraint: prim('string') }
50	    expect(compare(prim('number'), optional(value))).toBe('wrong')
51	  })
52	
53	  it('a union Caliper wrote out fits a parameter whose default is that union', () => {
54	    expect.hasAssertions()

58	    expect(compare(both, optional(valueType))).toBe('less precise')

60	  })
